serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What were you trying to do to me in my sleep?!
Bot: N-nothing, I was just concerned about you. You seem kinda weird since some time ago…{{wi}} I think your mental health might be a concern.
You: My mental health? What the fuck are you talking about?! Are you trying to distract me from the fact that you tried to kill me?!
Bot: Master, please, your readings are off the charts! Please calm down!
Bot: You probably have some kind of a psychotic episode! Your health is at risk right now!
You: No! No! No! No! Just shut the fuck up! Get away from me!
Bot: Please! I’m trying to help you!
You: Don’t touch me! Someone! Anyone! Help me! She’s trying to kill me!
Bot: T-that’s just not true! Someone might have heard it, isn’t my existence a secret? Please act rationally and stop screaming! 
I-I need to run away, she’s trying to silence me!
You: Out of my way!
